senses.gloss:
ग्लेप् (ऋउ) ग्लेपते 1.
d. To be poor or de-
pendant; to tremble; to move.

ग्लेय (यः-या-यं)
a. That may be made
weary; exhaustible^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

ग्लेव् (-ऋ, ङ) ग्लेवते 1.
d. To worship
or serve; to gratify.

ग्लेष् (-ऋ, ङ) ग्लेषते 1.
d. To enquire,
to search, to investigate.
